description: The workspace’s contact fields: the keys a contact’s attributes can hold. action list returns each field with how many contacts hold a value for it. action create adds one (key, label, type text, number, date, boolean or choice, choices for a choice field, required). action update (id) changes a field’s label, type, choices or required; its key stays. action delete (id) removes the field and every contact’s value for it. Creating, changing and deleting are for owners and admins. Deleting acts only on a confirmed call: without confirmation_token it deletes nothing and returns a preview and a token for a person to approve; called again with that token, it deletes.

after.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, to read the page after it. Omit for the first page.

choices.description: A choice field's options, 1 to 100 of them, each once; none otherwise.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

id.description: The id in the resource path.

limit.description: How many records to return. Defaults to 25, maximum 100.

name: contact_fields
title: Contact fields
